questions.q: With a file selected, **Alt+Enter** shows —
options: The file in a new window
questions.solution: **Alt+Enter** opens Properties (size, dates, attributes) — the keyboard way of right-clicking and choosing Properties.

questions.q: How many **different values** can **8 bits** represent?
questions.solution: 2⁸ = **256** values, from 0 up to 255. 'Largest value' would be 255; 'number of values' is 256.

questions.q: The default file extension of a PowerPoint 2007 or later presentation is —
questions.solution: **.pptx** is the Office Open XML default (X = XML). .ppt is 97-2003, .ppsx is a show, .potx is a template.

questions.q: Which part of the CPU performs subtraction and comparison operations?
questions.solution: Arithmetic (add, subtract) and logical (compare, AND/OR) operations are executed in the ALU. The program counter is a register holding the next instruction's address; the CU only coordinates.
questions.shortcut: Any verb like add/subtract/compare/AND-OR -> ALU, no matter how the question dresses it up.

questions.q:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

Mother said, "I will prepare your favourite dish tomorrow."
options: Mother said that she would prepare my favourite dish the next day.
Mother said that she would prepare my favourite dish tomorrow.
Mother said that she will prepare my favourite dish the next day.
Mother said that she would prepare your favourite dish the next day.
questions.solution: Three moves in one line: I → **she** (the speaker), your → **my** (the listener is the reporter), tomorrow → **the next day**, with will → would. 'Tomorrow' left behind is the half-shift; 'your favourite dish' leaves the pronoun in the quote.
questions.shortcut: Track every person word: I, your — then the time word.

questions.q:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

The girl said to her mother, "I cannot find my ribbon anywhere."
options: The girl told her mother that she can not find her ribbon anywhere.
The girl told her mother that she could not find my ribbon anywhere.
The girl said to her mother that she could not find her ribbon anywhere.
The girl told her mother that she could not find her ribbon anywhere.
questions.solution: said to → **told**; can steps to **could**; I and my follow the speaker → **she/her**. 'Can not find' splits and refuses the shift; 'my ribbon' hands the ribbon to the reporter; keeping 'said to her mother' leaves the direct frame standing.
questions.shortcut: can → could; both I and my belong to the speaker.

questions.q:
Select the option that can substitute the given group of words.

Government by religious leaders who claim to rule in the name of God
questions.solution: theo = God → **theocracy**. Monarchy is rule by a king; anarchy is the absence of any rule.

questions.q:
Select the word which is nearest in meaning to the given word.

TENACIOUS
questions.solution: *Tenacious* = holding on firmly, refusing to quit → **persistent**. 'Fragile' and 'sluggish' are the planted opposite-temperament options.

questions.q: Teflon, used in non-stick cookware, is a polymer of:
questions.solution: **Teflon** is polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE), made from **tetrafluoroethylene**. Vinyl chloride gives PVC, isoprene gives natural rubber and ethene gives polythene.

questions.q: Which classical dance is associated with the state of **Assam**?
questions.solution: **Sattriya** was created by Srimanta Sankaradeva's Vaishnava tradition and preserved in the **sattra** monasteries of Assam.

questions.q: **Disinvestment proceeds** of the government are classified as —
questions.solution: Selling government equity **reduces assets** — the defining mark of a capital receipt, along with borrowings and loan recoveries.

questions.q: The hot, dry summer wind that blows over the plains of north India is called the:
questions.solution: The **Loo** blows over the north Indian plains in May-June. Bora and Mistral are cold European winds; Chinook and Foehn are warm descending winds of the Rockies and Alps.
questions.shortcut: Loo = summer; Mistral = France; Chinook = 'snow eater' of the Rockies.

questions.q: If $α$ and $β$ are the roots of $x^2-3x+2=0$, then the value of $α^3+β^3$ is:
questions.solution: $\alpha+\beta = 3$, $\alpha\beta = 2$ → $\alpha^3+\beta^3 = 27 - 3\times2\times3 = 9$.

questions.q: If $\text{cosec}\theta+\cot\theta=3$, then $\sin\theta$ equals:
questions.solution:
$\text{cosec}\theta-\cot\theta=\frac13$ (reciprocal pair). Adding the two:

$2\,\text{cosec}\theta=\frac{10}{3}\Rightarrow\text{cosec}\theta=\frac53\Rightarrow\sin\theta=\frac35$.
questions.shortcut: Companion is $\frac1k=\frac13$; average the pair: cosec $=\frac{3+\frac13}{2}=\frac53$ → $\sin=\frac35$.

questions.q:
Annual sales of a company (₹ crore):

| Year | 2019 | 2020 | 2021 | 2022 | 2023 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sales | 160 | 200 | 260 | 250 | 320 |

The sales in 2020 are what percent of the sales in 2023?
Two cycles are sold at the same price, one at a gain of $16\frac{2}{3}\%$ and the other at a loss of $16\frac{2}{3}\%$. The net loss per cent on the total cost is:
questions.shortcut: 3% rounds the exact fraction 1/36 — keep it exact.

questions.q:
Select the term that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

**B2, D4, F8, H16, ?**
questions.solution: Letters B, D, F, H (+2) → J. Numbers 2, 4, 8, 16 (×2) → 32. Answer **J32**.

questions.q: If **× means ÷**, **÷ means +**, **+ means −** and **− means ×**, then what is the value of **[(60 × 4) + 5] − 2 ÷ 7**?
questions.solution: Rewrite: **[(60 ÷ 4) − 5] × 2 + 7**. Inner bracket: 60 ÷ 4 = 15. Square bracket: 15 − 5 = 10. Then 10 × 2 + 7 = 20 + 7 = **27**. (10 × (2 + 7) = 90 is the trap of adding before multiplying.)
questions.shortcut: Solve the brackets fully, then × before +.

questions.q:
Three of the following four pairs are alike in a certain way and one is different. Find the odd pair.

**Carpenter : Saw, Tailor : Needle, Farmer : Plough, Doctor : Hospital**
questions.solution: Carpenter - saw, tailor - needle and farmer - plough are **worker : tool**. A hospital is the doctor's **workplace**, not a tool → **Doctor : Hospital**.

questions.q: Five friends **R, S, T, U and V sit in a row facing south. R sits in the exact middle. T sits second to the left of R. V sits immediately to the right of R. S sits at an extreme end.** Who sits **immediately to the left of R** (from R's own facing)?
questions.solution: Facing south, R's left is the viewer's right. R (seat 3) → T is second to R's left = seat 5; V immediately to R's right = seat 2; S takes seat 1, leaving **U at seat 4 — immediately to R's left** (viewer's right of R).
questions.shortcut: South-facing row: swap 'left' and 'right' for the people, keep the end seats as drawn.
